# fLMCP — Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_tools_doc.py — do not edit by hand. -->

165 tools, 7 resources, 6 prompts. Parameters marked `?` are optional. **Kind**: `read` tools never change the project (clients may auto-approve them); `write ⚠` tools are flagged destructive in their MCP annotations.

Index conventions: channel indices are global and 0-based, pattern numbers are 1-based, mixer track 0 is Master.

Groups can be selected with `FLMCP_TOOLSETS` (see the README).

## `meta` — Bridge health, reconnection, raw access and tool discovery (6)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `fl_ping` |  | read | Check controller bridge connectivity and piano-roll script installation. |
| `fl_reconnect` |  | write | Reset the controller bridge client and return the new health status. |
| `fl_bridge_info` |  | read | Detailed info about the MIDI bridge (fails if it's offline). |
| `fl_call_raw` | action, params? | write ⚠ | Escape hatch: invoke any action the MIDI bridge accepts with arbitrary params. |
| `fl_introspect` | module?, search?, include_docs? | read | List the functions the running FL Studio actually exposes to scripts. |
| `fl_list_toolsets` |  | read | Show available groups and presets, enabled tools, and startup configuration. |

## `transport` — Playback, recording, tempo and time signature (14)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `transport_play` |  | write | Start or toggle playback (FL Studio's Play button). |
| `transport_stop` |  | write | Stop playback. |
| `transport_record` |  | write | Toggle record arm state. |
| `transport_status` |  | read | Read playback and record state, position in ticks/bars/seconds, loop mode and BPM. |
| `transport_set_position` | position, unit? | write | Seek from the start of the song in bars, seconds or ticks. Returns the position in bars. |
| `transport_song_length` |  | read | Return song length in ticks, seconds, ms, bars, steps. |
| `transport_set_loop_mode` | mode | write | Set FL Studio's song/pattern loop mode. |
| `transport_set_playback_speed` | speed | write | Set the playback speed multiplier (0.25..4.0). |
| `transport_set_tempo` | bpm | write | Set the project tempo in BPM. Uses processRECEvent for proper undo history. |
| `transport_tap_tempo` |  | write | Send a tap-tempo event (accumulates to set BPM). |
| `transport_set_time_signature` | numerator, denominator | write | Set project time signature (e.g. 4/4, 3/4, 7/8). |
| `transport_toggle_metronome` |  | write | Toggle metronome on/off. |
| `transport_toggle_countdown_before_recording` |  | write | Toggle 'countdown before recording'. |
| `transport_jog` | steps | write | Nudge playhead by `steps` 16th-notes (negative = backward). |

## `patterns` — Pattern selection and management (14)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pattern_count` |  | read | Count patterns in use (with content or a custom name) and the highest such index. |
| `pattern_current` |  | read | Return index + name of currently selected pattern. |
| `pattern_list` |  | read | List patterns in use plus the current one: 1-based index, name, color, length in steps (16 = one 4/4 bar). |
| `pattern_select` | index | write | Jump to pattern by index (1-based in FL). |
| `pattern_create` | name? | write | Create a new empty pattern. Returns {index, name}. |
| `pattern_rename` | index, name | write | Rename an existing pattern. |
| `pattern_set_color` | index, color | write | Set pattern color. Accepts '#RRGGBB' or 'rgb(r,g,b)'. |
| `pattern_clone` | index, new_name?, dest_index? | write | Copy a 1-based pattern (notes and step grid) and select the copy. |
| `pattern_delete` | index | write ⚠ | Clear the name of a 1-based pattern. The FL scripting API leaves the pattern and notes in place. |
| `pattern_set_length` | index, bars?, beats?, steps? | write | Set a 1-based pattern's length; give exactly one of bars, beats or steps. FL Studio 2026+. |
| `pattern_clear` | index | write ⚠ | Remove all notes and steps from a 1-based pattern, keeping the pattern. FL Studio 2026+. |
| `pattern_find_by_name` | name | read | Find a pattern by exact name (case-insensitive). Missing matches have null index and name. |
| `pattern_jump_to_next` |  | write | Select the next pattern in the list. |
| `pattern_jump_to_previous` |  | write | Select the previous pattern in the list. |

## `channels` — Channel Rack, channel settings and step sequencer (22)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `channel_count` | global_count? | read | Total channel count (global = across all groups). |
| `channel_info` | index | read | Return volume, pan, pitch, mixer routing and other details for a 0-based global channel index. |
| `channel_all` |  | read | List channels with 0-based global indices, names, controls and mixer routing. |
| `channel_get_swing` |  | read | Return the Channel rack's global swing, 0.0 (straight) to 1.0 (maximum). FL Studio 2026+. |
| `channel_set_swing` | amount | write | Set the Channel rack's global swing, 0.0 (straight) to 1.0 (maximum); clamped. FL Studio 2026+. |
| `channel_selected` |  | read | Return the selected channel's global index and name, or null values if none is selected. |
| `channel_select` | index, exclusive? | write | Select channel (exclusive=True deselects others). |
| `channel_set_volume` | index, volume | write | Set channel volume (0.0..1.0, where 0.78 ≈ 0 dB). |
| `channel_set_pan` | index, pan | write | Set channel pan (-1.0..1.0). |
| `channel_set_pitch` | index, semitones | write | Set channel pitch offset in semitones, subject to the channel's configured pitch range. |
| `channel_mute` | index, muted? | write | Mute / unmute / toggle (None = toggle). |
| `channel_solo` | index, solo? | write | Solo / unsolo / toggle (None = toggle). |
| `channel_set_name` | index, name | write | Rename a channel. |
| `channel_set_color` | index, color | write | Set channel color. Accepts '#RRGGBB' or 'rgb(r,g,b)'. |
| `channel_route_to_mixer` | index, mixer_track | write | Route a channel to a given mixer insert track. |
| `channel_trigger_note` | index, note, velocity?, duration_ms? | write | Send a note-on for a 0-based global channel. Pitch and velocity use 0–127. |
| `channel_get_grid_bit` | index, position | read | Read a single step-sequencer bit (position is 0-based step within the pattern). |
| `channel_set_grid_bit` | index, position, value | write ⚠ | Enable or clear a 0-based step in the selected pattern for a global channel index. |
| `channel_get_step_sequence` | index, pattern? | read | Read 0/1 step values, length and 1-based pattern index. Omit pattern to read the selected pattern. |
| `channel_set_step_sequence` | index, steps, pattern? | write ⚠ | Overwrite steps from index 0 with the given 0/1 values. Later steps stay as they were. Pattern indices start at 1. |
| `channel_clear_step_sequence` | index, pattern? | write ⚠ | Clear all step-sequencer bits for the channel (in the current or specified pattern). |
| `channel_quick_quantize` | index | write ⚠ | Select the channel and snap note starts in the current pattern using FL Studio's quick quantize. |

## `mixer` — Mixer inserts, routing, EQ and FX slots (18)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mixer_count` |  | read | Number of mixer tracks, including Master at index 0 (`count`); FL 2025.1+ also reports `insert_count`, the inserts without Master and the hidden Current track. |
| `mixer_track_info` | track | read | Read gain, pan, mute/solo/arm, stereo separation and FX slots for a mixer track. Track 0 is Master. |
| `mixer_all_tracks` | include_empty? | read | List mixer tracks and fader settings. Track 0 is Master. Set include_empty to include unnamed and default-named inserts. |
| `mixer_set_volume` | track, volume | write | Set mixer track volume (0.0..1.0). |
| `mixer_set_pan` | track, pan | write | Set mixer track pan (-1.0..1.0). |
| `mixer_mute` | track, muted? | write | Mute / unmute / toggle (None = toggle). |
| `mixer_solo` | track, solo? | write | Solo / unsolo / toggle. |
| `mixer_arm` | track, armed? | write | Set an insert's recording arm state. Omit armed to toggle. |
| `mixer_set_name` | track, name | write | Rename a mixer track. |
| `mixer_set_color` | track, color | write | Set mixer track color ('#RRGGBB' or 'rgb(r,g,b)'). |
| `mixer_set_stereo_separation` | track, separation | write | Set mixer track stereo separation (-1.0..1.0). |
| `mixer_set_send_level` | src_track, dst_track, level | write | Set send level from one mixer track to another (0..1). |
| `mixer_route` | src_track, dst_track, enabled? | write | Enable or disable a mixer route (send) between two tracks. |
| `mixer_fx_slots` | track | read | List plugin IDs in the 10 FX slots of a mixer track (-1 = empty). |
| `mixer_select` | track | write | Focus / select a mixer track. |
| `mixer_get_eq` | track | read | Read the mixer track's EQ bands with gain, frequency and bandwidth values where available. |
| `mixer_set_eq_band` | track, band, gain?, frequency? | write | Set one band of the mixer EQ. band=0\|1\|2 (low/mid/high). gain -1..1, freq 0..1 (normalised). |
| `mixer_link_to_channel` | channel, track, mode? | write | Link a 0-based global channel to a mixer track. The legacy mode argument is accepted for compatibility. |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plugin_is_valid` | index, slot?, location? | read | Check if a plugin slot has a valid plugin loaded. |

| `plugin_param_count` | index, slot?, location? | read | Return number of automatable parameters. |

| `plugin_find_param` | index, name_contains, slot?, location? | read | Find a parameter by substring (case-insensitive). |

| `plugin_set_preset` | index, preset, slot?, location? | write ⚠ | Request a preset by numeric index. If unsupported, use plugin_next_preset or plugin_prev_preset. |

## `playlist` — Playlist tracks, clip capabilities and timeline markers (14)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `playlist_track_count` |  | read | Return the number of Playlist tracks. |
| `playlist_track_info` | track | read | Read a Playlist track's name, color, mute/solo state and optional height. Use an index from playlist_all_tracks. |
| `playlist_all_tracks` | include_empty? | read | Return Playlist track indices and details. By default omit tracks with no name. |
| `playlist_set_track_name` | track, name | write | Rename a playlist track. |
| `playlist_set_track_color` | track, color | write | Set playlist track color ('#RRGGBB'). |
| `playlist_mute_track` | track, muted? | write | Set a Playlist track's mute state. Omit muted to toggle. |
| `playlist_solo_track` | track, solo? | write | Set a Playlist track's solo state. Omit solo to toggle. |
| `playlist_list_clips` | track? | read | Check clip enumeration for all tracks or one track. The FL scripting API currently returns a limitation note. |
| `playlist_place_pattern` | track, pattern, position_bars, length_bars? | write | Request placement of a pattern at a bar offset. The public FL API currently requires manual placement. |
| `playlist_delete_clip` | track, position_bars | write ⚠ | Request deletion of a clip at a bar offset. The public FL API currently requires manual deletion. |
| `playlist_refresh` |  | write | Force playlist repaint (use after bulk edits). |
| `playlist_list_markers` |  | read | Check timeline marker enumeration. The public FL API currently returns an availability note. |
| `playlist_add_marker` | position_bars, name? | write | Add a named timeline marker at a bar offset from the start (four quarter notes per bar). |
| `playlist_delete_marker` | index | write ⚠ | Request removal by timeline marker index. The public FL API currently requires manual deletion. |

## `piano_roll` — Read and edit notes using ComposeWithLLM (11)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `piano_roll_status` |  | read | Report whether the file-based piano-roll bridge is installed/reachable. |
| `piano_roll_add_notes` | notes, clear_first?, channel?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Add notes to a channel's piano roll (works WITHOUT MIDI). |
| `piano_roll_add_chord` | midi_notes, time_bars?, duration_bars?, velocity?, channel?, pattern? | write | Append simultaneous MIDI pitches at a zero-based time in bars, with a shared duration in bars and velocity from 0 to 1. |
| `piano_roll_add_arpeggio` | midi_notes, time_bars?, step_bars?, note_duration_bars?, velocity?, direction?, repeats?, channel?, pattern? | write | Append the given MIDI pitches in sequence. Start, spacing and note duration use bars of four quarter notes. |
| `piano_roll_delete_notes` | notes, channel?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Delete all notes matching a MIDI pitch and a start within 1/16 quarter note of time_bars. |
| `piano_roll_clear` | channel?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Remove every note in the (channel's) piano roll. |
| `piano_roll_read` | channel?, pattern? | read | Export piano-roll state with note count, pitches, timing in bars and quarters, and velocity. |
| `piano_roll_quantize` | grid_bars?, strength?, channel?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Move note starts toward a grid spaced in bars. Strength 0 leaves notes unchanged and 1 snaps fully. |
| `piano_roll_transpose` | semitones, channel?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Shift every note by N semitones. |
| `piano_roll_humanize` | timing_jitter_bars?, velocity_jitter?, channel?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Randomize note starts by timing_jitter_bars and normalized velocities by velocity_jitter. |
| `piano_roll_duplicate` | source_time_bars, length_bars, dest_time_bars, channel?, pattern? | write | Append a copy of notes starting inside the source range. Source, length and destination are in bars. |

## `generators` — Scales, chords, melodies, basslines and drum patterns (12)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gen_list_scales` |  | read | Return all supported scale names. |
| `gen_list_chord_qualities` |  | read | Return all supported chord quality names. |
| `gen_list_progressions` |  | read | Return all built-in Roman-numeral progressions. |
| `gen_list_drum_patterns` |  | read | Return all built-in drum patterns. |
| `gen_chord_notes` | root?, quality?, inversion? | read | Preview MIDI pitches for a chord. Supply a root with octave (e.g. C4) and a quality from gen_list_chord_qualities. |
| `gen_scale_notes` | root?, scale?, octaves? | read | Preview ascending MIDI pitches for the named scale and octave count, from a root such as C4 to the final octave root. |
| `gen_emit_chord_progression` | channel, progression?, root?, scale?, chord_length_bars?, octave_shift?, pattern?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | Write a preset chord progression with the given root, scale and duration per chord in bars. clear_first replaces existing notes. |
| `gen_emit_melody` | channel, root?, scale?, length_bars?, note_duration_bars?, octave_range?, seed?, pattern?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | Write a scale-constrained melody. Set length and nominal note duration in bars. Supply a seed to repeat the generated melody. |
| `gen_emit_bassline` | channel, progression?, root?, scale?, bar_length?, pattern_style?, pattern?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | Write a bassline following the selected progression's roots. bar_length sets the duration per chord in bars. |
| `gen_emit_drum_pattern_notes` | style?, midi_map?, step_bars?, repeats?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | Emit a drum groove to the currently-open piano roll as individual notes. |
| `gen_emit_drum_pattern_step_seq` | channel_map, style?, repeats?, pattern? | write ⚠ | Write a drum groove into the step sequencer (requires MIDI bridge). |
| `gen_emit_arpeggio` | channel, root?, quality?, direction?, step_bars?, length_bars?, velocity?, octaves?, pattern?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | Write an arpeggio across the requested octaves. step_bars sets both note length and spacing. length_bars sets the total duration. |

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `voice_list_devices` |  | read | List available microphones (indexes + names + default flag). |

## `audio` — Audio analysis, slicing and Drum & Bass workflows (6)

| Tool | Parameters | Kind | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `audio_analyze` | path, extract_melody?, polyphonic? | read | Analyze an audio file: tempo, key, onsets, loudness, (optional) notes. |
| `audio_slice` | path, output_dir?, max_slices? | write ⚠ | Slice audio at detected onsets; save each slice as WAV on disk. |
| `audio_melody_to_piano_roll` | path, bpm?, snap_to_detected_key?, transpose_semitones?, min_confidence?, polyphonic?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | Extract notes from an audio file and push them into the FL piano roll. |

| `song_to_dnb_flip` | audio_path, target_bpm?, dnb_style?, dnb_bars?, include_melody?, include_bass?, polyphonic?, clear_first? | write ⚠ | One-shot: take any audio file and turn it into a DnB flip in the FL piano roll. |

## Resources

| URI | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `fl://status` | Bridge + transport quick status. |
| `fl://project` | Project snapshot with BPM, timing resolution, counts and selection. |
| `fl://transport` | Live transport state (is_playing, position, tempo, loop mode). |
| `fl://channels` | Full channel rack as JSON. |
| `fl://mixer` | All mixer tracks as JSON. |

| `fl://playlist` | Playlist tracks and any clip or marker data the controller bridge can provide. |

## Prompts

| Prompt | Arguments | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `make_beat` (Make a Beat) | genre, bpm, bars | Build and verify a drum groove for a genre, tempo and loop length. |
| `write_chord_progression` (Write a Chord Progression) | key, mood | Choose, voice and verify a chord progression in the requested key and mood. |
| `hum_to_melody` (Hum to Melody) |  | Record a hummed phrase, review its transcription and write it to the piano roll. |
| `flip_song_to_dnb` (Flip Audio to Drum & Bass) | path | Analyze an audio file and make a short Drum & Bass sketch in FL Studio. |
| `mix_check` (Review a Mix) |  | Inspect faders, routing and EQ before proposing any mix changes. |
| `project_overview` (Project Overview) |  | Summarize FL Studio's current project, routing and selection without edits. |
